name: POSTed with costs, approved, then price change to the amount already paid (6 months in)
description: Copy of 'apprenticeship-posted-then-price-change-to-zero' with a subtler twist: instead of dropping the price to £0, the price is changed 6 months in to exactly the amount already earned on-programme by that point. Original price is £3,840 training + £960 EPAO (£4,800 total, deliberately kept under standard 297's £5,000 funding band maximum so the cap doesn't distort the sums) — on-programme total is 80% of £4,800 = £3,840 over 24 months (2026/27 AY, 2-year course), i.e. £160/month, so 6 months in exactly £960 has been earned. The price change sets the new total to £1,200 (£960 training + £240 EPAO), giving a new on-programme total of £960 (80% of £1,200) — identical to the amount already paid — so every remaining on-programme instalment from that point on is exactly £0 rather than negative or positive.

steps.name: SLD Submits Price Change to Amount Already Paid
